children: Greenbrier announced orders for 3,400 railcars totaling approximately $600 million in its fiscal fourth quarter.
Received orders for 3,400 new railcars with aggregate value of about $600 million for fiscal Q4.
Order book includes 780 railcars for Saudi Railway Company (SAR), spanning tank cars and intermodal units.
First sale of intermodal units to SAR; tank cars built from U.S. steel at North American operations in Mexico have begun shipping.
Company cites orders as validation of global demand and a foundation entering fiscal 2027 for infrastructure support.
